name: Ukuthintela ukukhawula
tagline: Iinketho zakho. Yintoni simahla. Yintoni efanele ubomi bakho.

what_is_it.heading: Ukuthintela ukukhulelwa ngokwemigaqo ecacileyo
what_is_it.lede: Ukuthintela ukukhawula kukuvumela ukuba ukhethe ukuba unabantwana nini na xa unabo. UMzantsi Afrika ubonelela ngeendlela ezininzi ezahlukeneyo - ezininzi zisimahla kwiikliniki zikarhulumente. Iindlela ezahlukeneyo zilungele ubomi obahlukeneyo.
paragraphs: Akukho ndlela 'engcono' - kuphela eyona ilungileyo kuwe ngoku. Ukhetho luxhomekeke kwiminyaka yakho, impilo, izicwangciso zabantwana, imeko yeqabane kunye nendlela yokuphila. Indlela elungileyo yile oya kuyisebenzisa rhoqo.

Zonke iikliniki zikarhulumente zibonelela ngoqingqo-nzala simahla. Awudingi ukubandakanya iqabane lakho, abazali (ukususela kwiminyaka eyi-12), okanye nabani na ongomnye. Ukugcinwa kweemfihlo kukhuselwe ngumthetho waseMzantsi Afrika - abasebenzi bezempilo abanako ukwabelana nabanye ngokhetho lwakho locwangciso ngaphandle kwemvume yakho.

items.headline: Konke simahla
items.body: Iipilisi, iinaliti, izifakelo, ii-IUDs, iikhondom - zonke zifumaneka simahla kuzo zonke iikliniki zikarhulumente.

items.headline: Iinketho ezininzi
items.body: Iipilisi zemihla ngemihla, iinaliti zenyanga, iinaliti zenyanga ezi-3, ii-implants ezithatha iminyaka emi-3, ii-IUD ezithatha iminyaka eyi-10.

items.headline: Iyimfihlo
items.body: Ukusukela kwi-12 leminyaka yobudala ungafikelela kwizicwangcisi ngasese. Abasebenzi bezempilo abanakuxelela abazali okanye amaqabane ngaphandle kwemvume yakho.

items.headline: Ipilisi yongxamiseko
items.body: Ipilisi yasekuseni isebenza ukuya kuthi ga kwiintsuku ezi-5 emva kokwabelana ngesondo - kodwa ngokukhawuleza kungcono. Zisimahla kwiikliniki, zifumaneka kwiikhemesti ezininzi.

pull_quote.text: Ziikhondom kuphela ezikhuselayo ekukhulelweni KUNYE NE-STIs. Iindlela zeHormonal zisebenza kakhulu ekukhulelweni kodwa aziniki khuselo kusulelo. Phinda kabini ukuba unako.

signs.heading: Yeyiphi indlela ehambelana nobomi bakho?
signs.lede: Akukho mpendulo ichanekileyo. Tshatisa indlela ebomini bakho-kwaye khumbula ukuba ungatshintsha nangaliphi na ixesha.

items.title: Ufuna ixesha elide, umzamo ophantsi
items.description: Ukufakelwa (iminyaka emi-3, intonga encinci kwingalo ephezulu) okanye i-IUD (iminyaka emi-3-10 kuxhomekeke kuhlobo). Zombini zisebenza kakhulu kwaye unokulibala ngazo xa sele zisendaweni.

items.title: Ufuna ulawulo lwenyanga
items.description: Ipilisi (ethathwa imihla ngemihla ngexesha elifanayo) okanye i-injection (ngenyanga okanye nge-3-ngenyanga). Kulungile ukuba unokufuna ukukhulelwa kunyaka ozayo okanye emibini.

items.title: Ufuna ukhuseleko lwe-STI nawe
items.description: Iikhondom zamadoda okanye zabasetyhini - ngalo lonke ixesha, kunye okanye ngaphandle kolunye ucwangciso. Kuphela ezi zikhusela kwi-HIV kunye nee-STIs.

items.fact: Zonke iindlela ezibuyiselwa umva vumela ukuchuma kwakho kubuye emva kokuyeka-kaninzi kwiinyanga. Akukho mpembelelo yexesha elide yokuba nabantwana kamva xa ubafuna.

items.myth: Awukwazi ukukhulelwa ngexesha lakho lokuqala, okanye ngelixa uncancisa.
items.fact: Unako ngokupheleleyo. Ngalo lonke ixesha sebenzisa izicwangcisi ukuba awufuni ukukhulelwa — okokuqala, ixesha, okanye naliphi na ixesha emva kokuzalwa.
IHormonal contraception ikhusela ukukhulelwa kuphela. Ngee-STIs kunye ne-HIV - iikhondom ngalo lonke ixesha, okanye i-PrEP ukuba isengozini ephezulu ye-HIV.

Ucwangciso olungxamisekileyo lusebenza phambi kokuba kuqale ukukhulelwa - kulibazisa ukuphuma kweqanda. Ayinakuphelisa ukukhulelwa okukhoyo. Ukupheliswa kokukhulelwa yinkonzo eyahlukileyo, yezomthetho.

items.title: Yiya kuyo nayiphi na ikliniki karhulumente
items.description: Ngena ngaphakathi. Cela ucwangciso. Baza kukuchazela iinketho kwaye bakuncede ukhethe. Akukho kuqeshwa kuyadingeka, akukho ncedo lwezonyango olufunekayo.

items.title: Zama indlela - kwaye utshintshe ukuba ayingeni
items.description: Iziphumo ebezingalindelekanga ngendlela enye ayithethi ukuba abanye baya kukunika iingxaki. Abasetyhini abaninzi bazama i-2 okanye i-3 ngaphambi kokufumana eyona ilungileyo. Ukutshintsha kusimahla.

items.title: Ukuba uphosa ipilisi - jonga iphecana
items.description: Iipilisi ezahlukeneyo zinemithetho eyahlukileyo. Ngokubanzi: thatha ipilisi ephosiweyo ngokukhawuleza ukuba ukhumbule, kwaye usebenzise iikhondom iintsuku ezisi-7 njenge-backup.

items.title: Ukuba ukwabelana ngesondo ngaphandle kokhuseleko kwenzeka
items.description: Ucwangciso olungxamisekileyo phakathi kweentsuku ezi-5. Zisimahla kwiikliniki. I-R30–80 kwiikhemesti ezininzi. Ngokukhawuleza kungcono. Ayithathi indawo yocwangciso oluqhelekileyo.

items.title: Abatshatileyo — zama ukwenza isigqibo kunye
items.description: Ucwangciso lusebenza ngcono xa omabini amaqabane exhasa ukhetho. Iikliniki ezininzi zinika izibini iingcebiso. Iziphumo zingcono xa ukwiphepha elinye.

get_help.heading: Masiye phi
get_help.lede: Uthintelo kukhulelwa yenye yeenkonzo zempilo zoluntu ezilungelelaniswe kakuhle eMzantsi Afrika. Isimahla, iyimfihlo, iyafumaneka kuye wonke umntu ukusuka kwiminyaka eyi-12.

helplines.name: Fumana eyona kliniki ikufutshane nawe
helplines.description: Ikliniki nganye karhulumente ibonelela ngothintelo-kukhulelwa kunye neengcebiso simahla
helplines.meta: Akukho kuqeshwa · akukho ncedo lwezonyango olufunekayo · iminyaka eyi-12+
